targets.label: Linux x64
targets.cmd: cd "$(mktemp -d)" && T=linux-x64 && V=$(curl -fsSLI -o /dev/null -w '%{url_effective}' https://github.com/GhostPawJS/affinity/releases/latest | sed 's|.*/v||') && F=ghostpaw-affinity-$V-$T.tar.gz && U=https://github.com/GhostPawJS/affinity/releases/download/v$V && curl -fsSL -O "$U/$F" -O "$U/SHA256SUMS" && grep " $F\$" SHA256SUMS | sha256sum -c - && tar -xzf "$F" ghostpaw-affinity && mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && mv ghostpaw-affinity ~/.local/bin/ && { case ":$PATH:" in *":$HOME/.local/bin:"*) ;; *) echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.profile; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH";; esac; } && ghostpaw-affinity --version

targets.label: Windows x64 (PowerShell)
targets.cmd: $r='GhostPawJS/affinity'; $v=(irm "https://api.github.com/repos/$r/releases/latest").tag_name; $f="ghostpaw-affinity-$($v.TrimStart('v'))-windows-x64.zip"; $u="https://github.com/$r/releases/download/$v"; $t=(New-Item -ItemType Directory (Join-Path $env:TEMP ([guid]::NewGuid()))).FullName; iwr "$u/$f" -OutFile "$t\$f" -UseBasicParsing; iwr "$u/SHA256SUMS" -OutFile "$t\SHA256SUMS" -UseBasicParsing; $want=((Get-Content "$t\SHA256SUMS" | Where-Object { $_ -like "* $f" }) -split '\s+')[0]; if (-not $want -or (Get-FileHash "$t\$f" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne $want) { throw "checksum mismatch for $f" }; $d=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\ghostpaw\bin'; Expand-Archive "$t\$f" $t -Force; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $d | Out-Null; Copy-Item "$t\ghostpaw-affinity.exe" $d -Force; $p=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','User'); if (";$p;" -notlike "*;$d;*") { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('Path',"$p;$d",'User') }; $env:Path="$d;$env:Path"; ghostpaw-affinity --version
